instruction: I bought a few Gildan Women's Softstyle Cotton T-Shirts on amazon this week. But only the one in large size fits me well. Initiate a return for the rest. Prefer FedEx as a deliverer, if available.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The agent must find this week's orders of the Gildan T-shirt (show_orders with query), inspect each order to get product ids/sizes (show_order), look up deliverer ids (show_return_deliverers) and initiate a quantity-1 return for every non-large T-shirt, two in total per the evaluation. Modeled with two returnable products (tshirt-other-1/2, sizes unknown) and the fitting large one blocked from return via the static (fits ?p) fact. Orders are modeled as two order objects; if at runtime both items are in the same order, both show_order steps use the same id. FedEx is assumed available (deliverer-available fedex in init) so the goal demands fedex as deliverer; if it were unavailable the agent would pick another deliverer. show_orders' optional query parameter is used. complete_task takes the two return records and the deliverer as non-API parameters so its precondition encodes the full goal; no answer is passed.
